10. Early Bootstrap Hook

            

                window.SpruceXBoot.initTheme() is configured before
                SpruceX initialization.
            

            

                

                    Hook installed:
                    
                

                

                    Dark class at render start:
                    
                

                
window.SpruceXBoot = {
  initTheme() {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('darkMode') || '{}');
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', !!saved.darkMode);
  }
};

12. Auto-Memoized Getters, Built-ins & markRaw

            

                Read-only getters on sx-data are automatically memoized via fine-grained
                dependency tracking. Date, Map, and 5,000-point
